sections.name: Patents
sections.intro: Patent prosecution across software, networks, medical devices, and mechanical designs, together with Patent Trial and Appeal Board representation.

matters.title: Child protection alerts
matters.result: Obtained utility patent protection for a system and method for providing child protection alerts.

matters.title: Laser-guided surgical tool
matters.result: Obtained utility patent protection for a laser-guided surgical tool.

matters.title: Wide-area network resource management
matters.result: Obtained utility patent protection for a system and architecture for robust management of resources in a wide-area network.

matters.title: Data mining software
matters.result: Prepared and prosecuted a utility patent application for a system, method, and computer program product for data mining applications, obtaining U.S. patent protection.

matters.title: Eyeglasses headband and choker
matters.result: Prosecuted a design patent application for an eyeglasses headband and choker design, obtaining U.S. design patent protection.

matters.title: Patent owner representation before the PTAB
matters.result: Represented a patent owner in the food service industry in five proceedings involving the USPTO pilot program for revised motions to amend.
matters.case: Red Diamond, Inc. v. Southern Visions, LLP
